topics.title: Six days above 2C
topics.summary: Global surface temperatures stayed more than 2C above preindustrial levels for six consecutive days, with a record 2.24C anomaly reported for Monday.
topics.discussionPrompt: When people hear one striking climate number, what helps make it feel meaningful: a local example, a clever visual, or a practical idea for what comes next?

topics.title: Dolphin friendships and longevity
topics.summary: A long-running Shark Bay study found Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins with strong, stable social groups tended to live longer.
topics.discussionPrompt: Do you think a few close friends or a big social circle makes life better? And would your answer change at different ages?

topics.title: New tools for flood forecasts
topics.summary: Researchers are studying differences in tidal height across beaches, a technique that could support more local flood forecasts.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a forecast could be tailored to your exact neighbourhood, what everyday plans would you trust it with first?

topics.title: Pakistan reaches China’s space station
topics.summary: China sent Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani astronaut to reach orbit, to the Tiangong space station in a milestone for international space cooperation.
topics.discussionPrompt: What kind of international project feels most exciting to share: a space station, a deep-sea lab, a giant telescope, or something else?

topics.title: Australia and Solomon Islands sign pact
topics.summary: Australia and Solomon Islands agreed a security pact, strengthening their relationship and reshaping regional diplomacy in the Pacific.
topics.discussionPrompt: When neighbouring countries make a new partnership, what matters most to ordinary people: safety, jobs, travel, or having a stronger voice?

topics.title: England funds coastal adaptation
topics.summary: England announced more than £11m for council-led coastal projects, including drone surveys, dune restoration and planning for roads threatened by erosion.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a shoreline near you was changing quickly, would you rather invest in protecting it, adapting around it, or relocating vulnerable places?

topics.title: UK energy bills set to rise
topics.summary: Britain’s energy price cap is set to rise 26% in January, pushing a typical annual household bill above £2,000 amid higher wholesale gas costs.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is one simple habit, gadget, or household change that actually makes a noticeable difference to an energy bill?

topics.title: Oats ride a fullness trend
topics.summary: Oat sales are climbing as shoppers look for foods that help them feel full longer, with porridge emerging as a popular everyday choice.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is your most dependable comfort breakfast, and does it have to be healthy to earn that title?

topics.title: New US tariff proposals
topics.summary: The United States proposed new tariffs affecting 14 trading partners, including China, Japan and the European Union, as officials cited unfair trade practices.
topics.discussionPrompt: When countries change trade rules, what everyday item do you think people notice first: food, clothes, electronics, or cars?

topics.title: A supermoon lights up skies
topics.summary: A Beaver supermoon was visible around the world, appearing especially large because the full moon coincided with a point near its closest approach to Earth.
topics.discussionPrompt: Are you the sort of person who steps outside for a sky event, or do you prefer enjoying the photos afterward with a warm drink?
